cases.expected: IllegalArgumentException with message "name must not be null"
cases.description: Calling removeRRset with a null Name should immediately throw an IllegalArgumentException before any other processing.
When the supplied type is not a valid DNS type, Type.check should raise an IllegalArgumentException, preventing the write‑lock from being acquired.
Type values larger than the 16‑bit DNS type range must also cause Type.check to throw.

cases.expected: no exception; zone state unchanged (findExactMatch returns null before and after)
cases.description: If the zone does not contain an RRset for the given name/type, removeRRset should succeed silently and leave the zone unchanged.

cases.expected: RRset removed; subsequent findExactMatch(name, Type.A) returns null
cases.description: When an RRset exists for the supplied name and type, removeRRset must acquire the write lock, invoke removeRRsetWithoutLock, and the RRset should no longer be retrievable.

cases.expected: withWriteLock's Runnable is executed exactly once
cases.description: Using a test subclass of Zone that overrides withWriteLock to record invocation, verify that removeRRset delegates the removal to withWriteLock exactly once for a valid call.

group: Removal behavior - multiple types same name

cases.expected: Only the A RRset is removed; the TXT RRset for the same name remains (findExactMatch(name, Type.A) == null, findExactMatch(name, Type.TXT) != null)
cases.description: A zone contains two RRsets for the same owner name but different types (A and TXT). After removeRRset(name, Type.A) the A RRset must disappear while the TXT RRset stays intact.
DNS names are case‑insensitive. The zone stores an A RRset under a lower‑case name; calling removeRRset with an upper‑case representation must still locate and delete the RRset.

group: Locking verification - invalid type does not acquire lock

cases.expected: IllegalArgumentException from Type.check; withWriteLock is never invoked
cases.description: When the supplied type is invalid, removeRRset should fail before entering the write‑lock path. A Zone subclass that records calls to withWriteLock must show zero invocations.

cases.expected: NS RRset removed from the zone apex; subsequent getNS() returns null (or a new empty NS RRset)
cases.description: The zone apex normally contains an NS RRset. Removing it via removeRRset should succeed and the zone's getNS() accessor must reflect the removal.

cases.expected: Iterator returned by zone.iterator() no longer yields the removed RRset, while other RRsets remain present
cases.description: After adding several RRsets (including the target A RRset) and invoking removeRRset, iterating over the zone must not produce the deleted RRset, confirming internal collection consistency.

cases.expected: No exception; zone remains empty (findExactMatch returns null before and after)
cases.description: Calling removeRRset on an entirely empty zone should be a no‑op and must not throw any exception.
